origin.description: Report whether an object is a recorded plot.
origin.details: True for a plot display list captured during evaluate.
origin.example:
ev <- evaluate("plot(1)")
cat("plot(1) is a plot:", is.recordedplot(ev[[2]]), "\n")
cat("A number is not:", is.recordedplot(1), "\n")

translation.description: Report whether an object is a recorded plot.
translation.details: True for a plot display list captured during evaluate.
translation.example:
print("plot(1) is a plot:", is_recordedplot(evaluate("plot(1)", envir={})[1]))
print("A number is not:", is_recordedplot(1))
